the pinned client pair does not co-install under npm's default peer resolution (npm error peer @honua/sdk-js@"^0.1.4-beta.0" from @honua/mcp-server@0.1.4-beta.0); npm's caret ranges exclude prereleases with a different patch tuple, so the exact manifest-verified bytes were installed with --legacy-peer-deps. the pinned `honua-mcp-proxy` executable exits silently when launched through npm's node_modules/.bin shim; its published entry point is guarded on `process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`, which the shim path never satisfies. The same pinned bytes were launched by their resolved module path to read the tool surface (resolved module path). This is a defect in the pinned client artifact, not in the candidate server.
